info.name: Gymora API
info.description:
# Gymora API Postman Collection

## Overview

Complete Postman collection for the Gymora ASP.NET Core 9.0 REST API.

## Architecture

- **Authentication:** JWT Bearer Token with Refresh Tokens
- **Identity:** ASP.NET Core Identity with `ApplicationUser` (int PK)
- **Roles:** `SuperAdmin`, `User`
- **Rate Limiting:** IP-based fixed window policies
- **Global Exception Handling:** Custom middleware returning `Result<T>` envelope
- **ORM:** Entity Framework Core with SQL Server
- **Background Jobs:** Hangfire + MassTransit InMemory + EF Outbox
- **File Storage:** Bunny.net (Stream + Storage)
- **Payment:** Paymob integration
- **Validation:** DataAnnotations

## Authentication Flow

1. `POST /api/Auth/register` — Creates account + sends confirmation OTP
2. `POST /api/Auth/confirm-email` — Confirms with OTP (or use GET variant)
3. `POST /api/Auth/login` — Returns JWT + Refresh Token
4. All protected requests automatically use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`
5. `POST /api/Auth/refresh-token` — When access token expires
6. `POST /api/Auth/logout` — Revokes refresh token

## Rate Limiting Policies

| Policy Name | Limit | Window | Endpoints |
|------------|-------|--------|-----------|
| `Ip_5Limit_1Min` | 5 requests | 1 minute | POST /api/Auth/login |
| `Ip_3Limit_5Min` | 3 requests | 5 minutes | POST resend-confirmation-email, POST forgot-password |
| `Ip_10Limit_1Min` | 10 requests | 1 minute | POST verify-otp, POST reset-password, GET confirm-email |

## Standard Response Envelope

### Success
```json
{
  "isSuccess": true,
  "data": { ... }
}
```

### Error
```json
{
  "isSuccess": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Description"
  }
}
```

### Error Codes

| HTTP Status | Code | Description |
|------------|------|-------------|
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` | Invalid input / business rule violation |
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Model state validation failed |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid JWT |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Insufficient role permissions |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | Resource not found |
| 409 | `CONFLICT` | Duplicate resource |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Too many requests |
| 500 | `SERVER_ERROR` | Internal server error |

## Token Variables

This collection uses role-specific token variables for testing authorization:

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `accessToken` / `refreshToken` | Default tokens (set by Login) |
| `superAdminAccessToken` / `superAdminRefreshToken` | SuperAdmin role tokens (set by Login as SuperAdmin) |
| `userAccessToken` / `userRefreshToken` | User role tokens (set by Login) |

item.name: 03 Payment Requests
item.description: Payment Request management with full CRUD operations and pagination. Payment requests include proof of payment uploads (images) and an approval workflow (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled).

request.description:
Get a paginated list of payment requests with optional search, sorting, and filtering.

## Request Body Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `pageNumber` | int | 1 | Page number (1-based) |
| `pageSize` | int | 10 | Page size (max 50) |
| `searchTerm` | string | null | Search term (max 100 chars) |
| `orderBy` | string | "Id" | Property to order by |
| `orderDirection` | string | "asc" | Sort direction: "asc" or "desc" |
| `isActive` | bool | true | Filter by active status |
| `createdById` | int | null | Filter by creator |
| `filters` | object | null | Advanced filtering (BetweenFilters, ExactFilters) |

## Pagination Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `totalCount` | number | Total items matching the query |
| `pageSize` | number | Items per page |
| `pageNumber` | number | Current page |
| `totalPages` | number | Total number of pages |
| `hasPrevious` | boolean | Whether a previous page exists |
| `hasNext` | boolean | Whether a next page exists |
| `items` | array | PaymentRequest items for current page |

### Requires Authentication: No (AllowAnonymous)

Get a single payment request by its ID.

## Route Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int | Payment Request ID |

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | number | Payment request ID |
| `planId` | number | Subscription Plan ID |
| `planPriceId` | number | Plan Price ID |
| `subscriptionId` | number | Subscription ID (if approved) |
| `couponId` | number | Applied coupon ID |
| `couponCode` | string | Applied coupon code |
| `originalAmount` | number | Amount before discount |
| `discountAmount` | number | Discount amount |
| `finalAmount` | number | Amount after discount |
| `currencyCode` | string | ISO currency code |
| `proofUrl` | string | Payment proof file URL |
| `status` | number | 1=Pending, 2=Approved, 3=Rejected, 4=Cancelled |
| `reviewNotes` | string | Admin review notes |
| `rejectionReason` | string | Rejection reason |
| `reviewedBy` | number | Admin user ID who reviewed |
| `reviewedAt` | string | Review timestamp |
| `fileUrl` | string | Uploaded proof file URL |
| `createdOn` | string | Creation timestamp |
| `createdById` | number | Creator user ID |
| `modifiedOn` | string | Last modification timestamp |

### Requires Authentication: No (AllowAnonymous)

request.description:
Submit a new payment request with proof of payment.

This endpoint uses `multipart/form-data` (`[FromForm]`) to accept a file upload along with metadata.

On success, the **createdEntityId** collection variable is automatically set to the new payment request's ID.

## Form Data Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `PlanId` | number | Yes | Subscription Plan ID |
| `PlanPriceId` | number | Yes | Plan Price ID |
| `CouponCode` | string | No | Coupon code to apply |
| `File` | file | Yes | Payment proof image (JPG or PNG, max 3MB) |

### File Validation
- Allowed types: JPG, PNG
- Max size: 3MB (enforced by `AllowedFileTypes` attribute)

### Requires Authentication: Yes

### Rate Limiting

None.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `Status` | number | Yes | 1=Pending, 2=Approved, 3=Rejected, 4=Cancelled |
| `ReviewNotes` | string | No | Admin review notes |
| `RejectionReason` | string | No | Rejection reason |
| `ReviewedBy` | number | No | Reviewer user ID |
| `ReviewedAt` | string | No | Review timestamp (ISO-8601) |
| `File` | file | No | Updated payment proof image |

### Requires Authentication: Yes

### Rate Limiting

None.
